At some point after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="FDCR" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> disputes over fishing and [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] rights between [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] and [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Colonist/Legends|settler]] groups on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Truuine]] eventually degenerated into a violent '''conflict'''. It led several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to avoid visiting Truuine.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
